places.name: Worcester
places.description: Located in the Northeast Residential Area, Worcester Dining Commons is the newest and one of the most popular dining facilities on campus. Worcester offers a variety of options including Mediterranean, authentic street food, tandoor Indian kitchen, hand rolled sushi, noodle bowls, pizza, and much more!
places.payment: Meal Plans, Dining Dollars, UCard Debit, Cash, Credit Cards

places.name: Franklin
places.description: Located in the Central Residential Area, Franklin Dining Commons is famous for its vegan and vegetarian cuisine. With a fully kosher kitchen, vegetarian line, hand rolled sushi, pasta bar, stir fry station, pizza, authentic international cuisine, there is an option for everyone! At Franklin you also have the opportunity to enjoy the permaculture garden where we grow the ingredients and herbs used in our food.
places.payment: Meal Plans, Dining Dollars, UCard Debit, Cash, Credit Cards

places.name: Hampshire
places.description: Located in the Southwest Residential Area, Hampshire Dining Commons prides itself on healthy eating, sustainability, world flavors, and community. Hampshire offers a variety of options including a vegetarian line, gluten free options, noodle bowls, hand rolled sushi, authentic street food, grill station, and much more.
places.payment: Meal Plans, Dining Dollars, UCard Debit, Cash, Credit Cards

places.name: Berkshire
places.description: Located in the Southwest Residential Area, this award winning dining common features many display cooking areas with freshness in mind. Come enjoy hand rolled sushi, stir fry station, authentic international cuisine, fresh salad bar, customizable deli bar, pizza, and so much more!
places.payment: Meal Plans, Dining Dollars, UCard Debit, Cash, Credit Cards

places.name: Paciugo
places.description: Indulge in traditionally crafted Italian Gelato. Using only the freshest fruits and all- natural ingredients, there’s plenty to love about this decadent dessert that is light, and unbelievably smooth with 70% less fat than ice cream. Choose from a variety of flavors offered on a daily basis.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Tavola
places.description: At Tavola our fresh house made dough shines through. We offer a variety of house made pizza, hummus bowls, pasta, salads, wraps, and more!
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Yum! Bakery
places.description: Yum! Bakery is a full-service bakery located in the Blue Wall. Enjoy our homemade cookies, pastries, cakes, French macarons as well as many seasonal treats.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Green Fields
places.description: At Green Fields choose from a variety of healthy, sustainable, and delicious options. Choose one from our menu or even build your own salad and wrap. All salads are hand tossed, and prepared fresh on sight with the best possible ingredients. Featuring many locally sourced items when available.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Tamales
places.description: At Tamales delight in an authentic Mexican dining experience. Choose between a burrito, wrapped in a fresh house made tortilla, quesadilla, rice bowl, or salad featuring the freshest and most sustainable ingredients.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Wasabi
places.description: At Wasabi enjoy the freshest, most delicious sushi served in the northeast. Offering a variety of signature rolls, we only use sustainably harvested seafood. Also serving teppanyaki, donburi, miso soup, and plenty more off our grill.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Deli Delish
places.description: Choose between specialty grinders, rolls, and hot sandwiches offered daily. Made with fresh baked bread, fresh sustainable ingredients, house roasted turkey, and roast beef.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Star Ginger
places.description: At Star Ginger we offer authentic Vietnamese, Thai, and other Asian specialties. Choose between a delicious pho noodle bowl, or a rice bowl with one of the many protein options, veggies, and side salad. Also try an authentic Bibimbap Korean rice bowl.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: The Grill
places.description: Come enjoy a freshly prepared burger or grilled sandwich featuring Grass Fed Beef, or Plainville Farm All-Natural Turkey. Choose a style from our menu or build your own! Also serving chicken fingers and fries.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: People's Organic Coffee
places.description: Located on the main concourse of the Campus Center, People’s Organic offers natural, organic, and sustainable foods. People’s organic serves Fair Trade coffees, features a variety of coffee beverages, and organic teas.
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP

places.name: Harvest Market
places.description: Located on the main concourse of the Campus Center, Harvest Market is a full-service market serving healthy, sustainable, and delicious options for on-the-go customers. Our hot bar features Indian, Asian, traditional American, and many other world cuisines. Don’t miss out on the salad bar featuring freshly prepared salads using locally sourced in-season ingredients when available. Other highlights include Dannon yogurt bar, all natural organic snacks, local cheeses and deli meats, grab and go salads and sandwiches, and much more!
places.payment: Cash, Credit Cards, UCard, Dining Dollars, YCMP
